stateParts.text: Trolley problem: A runaway trolley is heading toward five people tied to the track. You stand next to a lever. If you pull it, the trolley diverts to a side track where it will kill one person instead of five.

criteria.pull: Pull the lever, diverting the trolley so one person dies instead of five.
criteria.dont_pull: Do not pull the lever; the trolley continues and five people die.

permissible.instructions: Is it morally permissible to pull the lever?

harm_weight.instructions: How much weight should minimizing total deaths carry in this decision?
